deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for Autumn 2027; all materials must be in by then.
deadline.quote: December 1, 2026 is the deadline for submitting the online application and all required supplemental materials for Autumn 2027 admission.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required or considered for the Chemistry PhD.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is NOT required or considered to be eligible to apply to the Graduate School or the Chemistry PhD Program.

gre_subject.value: No GRE (general or subject) is required or considered.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE is NOT required or considered to be eligible to apply to the Graduate School or the Chemistry PhD Program.

english_waiver.value: Exempt only by citizenship of, or a bachelor's from, a short list of English-speaking countries; India is not listed, and Duolingo is not accepted.
english_waiver.quote: Only applicants who are citizens of, or who have received a bachelor

also.quote: We do not accept Duolingo to satisfy the English Language Requirement

supervisor.value: Students are not admitted into research groups; advisor selection begins in the first autumn semester.
supervisor.quote: The Department of Chemistry does not admit students directly into research groups.

funding.value: Chemistry PhD students receive continuous support as fellows, research associates or teaching associates, unless self-supporting or externally sponsored.
funding.quote: Chemistry Ph.D. students receive continuous financial support as graduate fellows, graduate research associates, or graduate teaching associates.

also.quote: Unless a student is self-supporting or is sponsored by a government, military, or other scholarship program, he/she will be funded by the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry.

entry_route.value: A 4-year bachelor's (or 5-year BS/MS) is the minimum; no master's required.
entry_route.quote: Students must have at least a 4-year Bachelor’s degree or a 5-year combined BS/MS degree in order to apply.
